contract_payload.capability: Maintain and retrieve a running sum of signed integers in memory.
completion_criteria: The RunningTotal class is implemented in running_total.py.
The class supports adding signed integers and retrieving the current total.
The implementation is dependency-free and uses in-memory storage.
error_semantics: TypeError if add() is called with a non-integer
AttributeError if total() is called on a non-instance
invariants: The total must always be an integer.
The total must be updated only by the add() method.

observable_requirements.observable_outcome: A new RunningTotal instance has a total of 0.
observable_requirements.test_hint: Assert total() returns 0 immediately after instantiation.

observable_requirements.observable_outcome: Calling add(amount) updates the total by the signed integer amount.
observable_requirements.test_hint: Call add(10) and verify total() is 10.

observable_requirements.observable_outcome: Calling total() returns the current value without modifying it.
observable_requirements.test_hint: Call total() multiple times and ensure the value remains constant.

observable_requirements.observable_outcome: Adding 3 and then -1 results in a total of 2.

contract_payload.requirement_source: Provide a RunningTotal class in running_total.py. A newly created RunningTotal starts with a total of zero. Calling add(amount) adds the signed integer amount to its running total. Calling total() returns the current total without changing it. Adding 3 and then -1 must expose a total of 2. Keep the implementation dependency-free and in memory.

source_clauses.text: A newly created RunningTotal instance must start with a total of zero.
Calling add(amount) must add the signed integer amount to the running total.
Calling total() must return the current total without changing it.
Adding 3 and then -1 must result in a total of 2.
